scope: C1 bind-gate witness, the deferred-rebind repair and the overlap observation: test_c1_rebind_witness, test_c1_rebind_on (CPU ring fixture); no box or GPU evidence

leaves.name: held-receiver-device-events
leaves.test: test_c1_rebind_witness.ReceiverHold (held chunks: the first in Witness, DelayedConsumption, Stops; every chunk or a random subset under RebindBase.late_consumer_tick in PeerIdentity and Bounded)
leaves.replaces: the CUDA events LaneDispatcher._record records on the receiving stage's prefill stream for chunk n's last LAYER, its SUFFIX and its STATE_FINALIZE, and the state_event _do_state_finalize records, while those kernels are still running
leaves.equivalence: the events are r4's ControllableEvent objects the real dispatcher created and recorded; only their host query differs: it answers False (cudaEventQuery's cudaErrorNotReady) until the test releases the hold, by undoing the network's complete_all for exactly these events. The STATE_FINALIZE record's event is the one _after_record hands to channel.consumer_done, so pp_consumer_complete() is False for its real reason and the bridge's report carries no PP_CONSUMER proof. No RPC, reply, RELEASE, receipt or logical acknowledgement is delayed; every other event (stage 0's, the PP receive's, stage 1's PREPARE/PREFIX/first layer) completes at the network's normal rate
leaves.cannot_prove: device timing or that kernels of two chunks run concurrently on the box; the witness shows only which host submissions the engine and workers make while stage 1's late work is incomplete

leaves.name: sender-channel-spy
leaves.replaces: nothing: it wraps the stage-0 FakePPChannel's bind_consumer, send and validate_consumer_proof and records around them
leaves.equivalence: each wrapper calls the wrapped method with the same arguments and returns its answer or raises its exception; it records the channel's consumer_binding at each send (on the ticket), bind and proof validation, and the live (non-retired) tickets, and appends a violation when a proof is validated under a binding other than its ticket's own, when a bind meets a live ticket, or when a send meets a live send
leaves.cannot_prove: the real PrefillPPChannel's slot accounting on device; its bind/validate code is the same rule (lane_comm.PrefillPPChannel.bind_consumer refuses with live tickets, validate_consumer_proof checks the channel-wide binding)

leaves.name: late-consumer-schedule
leaves.replaces: a receiving stage whose final layer and state finalize take longer than the sending stage's next chunk
leaves.equivalence: the held-receiver-device-events leaf, released per chunk once that chunk's deferred successor has waited at its PP_SEND for `patience` ticks, or after `cap` ticks; every other completion and RPC is the network's ordinary tick

leaves.name: observe-line-capture
leaves.replaces: engine_driver._progress_logger() as read by stage_overlap (the vLLM engine logger)
leaves.equivalence: the observer formats each line itself and passes it as the single %s argument of logger.info; the capture keeps exactly that formatted text; nothing else in stage_overlap logs through it on these stacks (driver.progress is None)
leaves.cannot_prove: docker log splitting or interleaving with other log lines on the box; the read refuses torn or duplicate parts

leaves.name: observer-counter-clock
leaves.replaces: time.monotonic_ns, the observer's clock (the engine's CLOCK_MONOTONIC, as the 'n' progress rows)
leaves.equivalence: a strictly increasing counter read at the same calls (submit, apply); the observer and the read use times only through order comparisons, which a non-decreasing clock and a strictly increasing counter give alike except for equal readings, where the read's strict < answers NONE
leaves.cannot_prove: real durations or margins in ns

leaves.name: synthetic-reports
leaves.replaces: WorkerCompletionReport and SegmentDescriptor objects reaching OverlapSegmentDriver._ingest_report
leaves.equivalence: OverlapObserver.note_report reads only worker_rank, pending_op_seqs, completed_op_seqs of the report and kind, layer_start of the descriptor; the interleavings are ones the one-command-per-stage driver can produce (a stage-0 reply and a stage-1 poll in flight together)
leaves.cannot_prove: that the box produces these interleavings; the connected Observe tests run the real reports
